note: Node, CLI and browser measurements use published Merman 0.11.0 artifacts. The browser comparison uses the npm package @mermanjs/web with the v0.11.0 Playground and Mermaid.js 12.3.0. The native layout work probe uses a local benchmark checkout.

cli.sample_unit: One sequential batch per sample and product, with a fresh CLI process per diagram. Render groups use median sums of process milliseconds. Complete batches use median wall milliseconds.
cli.output_scope: SVG at each renderer's font and layout settings

cli.sample_unit: One sequential batch per sample and product, with a fresh CLI process per diagram. Render groups use median sums of process milliseconds. Complete batches use median wall milliseconds.
cli.output_scope: Merman native rasterization and mmdc browser screenshots use each renderer's fonts and dimensions

rust_work.sample_unit: One frozen Flowchart topology per native probe. Minimum passing budget is measured on the layout writer. Consumed layout work units are recorded on the high-budget public SVG.

browser.sample_unit: Each measured block runs both engines once in balanced AB/BA order. A fresh Chromium process hosts each fixture. Cold uses a new realm and warm reuses the engine.
